headline: **MLB Daily Recap: August 2, 2026**
article:
The Toronto Blue Jays secured a 5-1 victory over the St. Louis Cardinals, with Kevin Gausman earning the win after 5.2 innings of work. George Springer led the Blue Jays' offense with 2 hits, 2 RBIs, and 4 at-bats. In a contrasting result, the Cardinals took down the Blue Jays 5-1 in a separate matchup, with Jordan Walker contributing significantly at the plate.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Jake Fraley (Tampa Bay Rays) who was placed on the 60-day injured list due to a hernia. Lenyn Sosa (Toronto Blue Jays) was also placed on the 60-day injured list with a right wrist contusion. The Atlanta Braves placed Reynaldo López on the 15-day injured list retroactive to July 30, 2026, due to left knee inflammation.

The Tampa Bay Rays made a significant trade, acquiring Freddy Peralta from the New York Mets in exchange for RHP Gary Gill Hill, OF Aidan Smith, and SS Émilien Pitre. The Chicago Cubs traded RHP Jameson Taillon to the Toronto Blue Jays for a player to be named later, and the Los Angeles Dodgers traded CF Zyhir Hope, RHP River Ryan, and RHP Brady Smith to the Detroit Tigers for LHP Tarik Skubal.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Fall to Blue Jays 5-1**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays secured a 5-1 victory over the St. Louis Cardinals, with Kevin Gausman earning the win after 5.2 innings of work. George Springer led the Blue Jays' offense with 2 hits, 2 RBIs, and 4 at-bats.

top_news.title: **Mariners Edge Twins in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Seattle Mariners secured a 4-3 victory over the Minnesota Twins, with Randy Arozarena's 2-hit performance including a home run and 1 RBI. Logan Gilbert led the Mariners' pitching effort with 7.0 innings pitched, 6 strikeouts, and 3 earned runs allowed.

top_news.title: **Rays Take Down White Sox 1-0**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays secured a narrow victory over the Chicago White Sox with a final score of 1-0. Drew Rasmussen led the way for the Rays, pitching 6.0 innings with 10 strikeouts and no earned runs.

top_news.title: **Marlins Take Down Mets 6-2**
top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins secured a 6-2 victory over the New York Mets, with Javier Sanoja leading the offense. Sanoja hit 2 home runs and drove in 2 runs in 5 at-bats.

top_news.title: **Nationals Fall Short in Atlanta**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals suffered a 2-4 loss to the Atlanta Braves, marking their defeat in the matchup. Matt Olson and Mike Yastrzemski were among the impact hitters in the game.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Take Down Blue Jays 5-1**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals secured a 5-1 victory over the Toronto Blue Jays, with Jordan Walker contributing significantly at the plate. Matthew Liberatore played a key role in the win on the mound.

top_news.title: **Rays Place Jake Fraley on 60-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Tampa Bay Rays right fielder Jake Fraley has been placed on the 60-day injured list due to a hernia. The move is effective immediately.

top_news.title: **Rays Acquire Freddy Peralta in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays have acquired RHP Freddy Peralta in a trade with the New York Mets. In exchange, the Mets received RHP Gary Gill Hill, OF Aidan Smith, and SS Émilien Pitre.
